name: RecruITIG
title: recruIT FHIR IG
description: FHIR Implementation Guide for the recruIT clinical trial patient recruitment support system.

resource.name: Eligibility observation derived-from Library
resource.description: A reference to the eligibility-criterion Library resource this Observation was derived from. Observation.derivedFrom does not accept Library as a target type, so this extension carries the reference instead.

resource.name: EligibilityGroupIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for the Group containing references to one or more eligibility criteria Library resources

resource.name: EligibilityObservationIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a per-criterion eligibility Observation's business identifier

resource.name: GroupCharacteristic
resource.description: An entity referenced in a characteristic

resource.name: ListBelongsToStudy
resource.description: The ResearchStudy the list manages candidates for

resource.name: ObservationDerivedFromLibrary
resource.description: The Library resource containing the eligibility criterion this Observation was derived from

resource.name: recruIT eligibility observation category
resource.description: A custom, non-standard Observation.category code identifying the synthetic per-criterion eligibility Observations produced by the sql-on-fhir eligibility engine, distinguishing them from genuine clinical Observations elsewhere in the system.

resource.name: RecruitResearchStudy
resource.description: A profile for the ResearchStudy resource used to represent a clinical trial.

resource.name: RecruitResearchStudyExample
resource.description: An example of a recruIT ResearchStudy.

resource.name: ResearchStudyEnrollment
resource.description: The Group resource representing the study enrollment

resource.name: ResearchSubjectIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a recruIT-created ResearchSubject's business identifier

resource.name: Screening list clinical study reference
resource.description: A reference to the clinical study that this screening list contains study candidates for

resource.name: ScreeningList
resource.description: A profile for the List resource used to represent a list of identified study candidates.

resource.name: ScreeningListIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a screening List's business identifier, which is the study's own identifier - used as the conditional-update key for a study's screening List.

resource.name: Test
resource.description: An example of a screening list.
